name: A thinker's harvest status (the Referee)

values.gloss: created, identity not yet confirmed (the column default)
identity confirmed, harvest not started (the UI says Ready)
harvest finished with gaps, coverage not closed

note: Corrected by the Referee 2026-09-06 (the mirror had missed pending and disambiguated). Field `status` on cohort-context members[], /api/thinkers/{id} and /api/thinkers/search; a free column by convention, the Referee tells first if a value is added; one legacy row 'exhausted_with_gaps' reads as incomplete. A zero against a complete thinker is stronger than one against a pending one.
